## SWOT ANALYSIS

### ✓ Strengths
- **Premium brand positioning** appeals to quality-conscious coffee consumers
- **Ethical sourcing and sustainability credentials** resonate with conscious consumers (per additional context)
- **Digital-first approach** enables precise targeting and measurement
- **Subscription model** creates recurring revenue and customer loyalty
- **Clear understanding of target audiences:** Coffee enthusiasts, Specialty coffee drinkers, Young professionals

### ✗ Weaknesses
- **Premium pricing** may limit addressable market size vs. mainstream brands
- **Budget range ($250K-$500K)** constrains reach in competitive coffee market
- **New brand** (implied) requires awareness building before conversion focus

### → Opportunities
- **Growing demand for sustainable products** creates favorable market conditions  
- **Subscription model** enables customer lifetime value optimization and predictable revenue
- **Digital channels** allow efficient targeting of coffee enthusiasts at scale
- **Social media and influencer partnerships** can rapidly build brand awareness
- **National scale campaign** (US National focus) enables testing across diverse markets
- **Morning dayparting** provides premium inventory during peak coffee intent

### ⚠ Threats
- **Intense competition** from established premium brands (Blue Bottle, La Colombe, Trade Coffee)
- **Subscription fatigue** - consumers overwhelmed by subscription options
- **Economic sensitivity** - premium coffee is discretionary spending
- **Supply chain volatility** for ethically-sourced beans could impact pricing
- **Rising digital advertising costs** may impact campaign efficiency
